product_one_liner.value: Dengage is a customer experience data platform for marketers that unifies customer data and automates personalized, AI-powered engagement across email, SMS, WhatsApp, push notifications and on-site channels.

pricing_page.notes: Public Core, Pro and Enterprise packages; a sales conversation is required for a quote.

employee_band.notes: The company reports 170+ employees; a separate October 2026 directory estimate is 148. Both indicate this band.

eng_blog.notes: The blog is aimed at marketers; the architecture article is attributed to Product, CX & Marketing teams, not engineers. No qualifying engineering-blog series was found.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable job board lists five openings: Full Stack Developer, Software Engineering Intern and three Business Development Representative roles; none has a qualifying AI/ML/data-science title. The official careers board does not expose a readable role list.

model_provider.notes: No underlying model or external model provider was identified after reviewing Zeki AI product information, AI documentation, the blog, Trust Center, privacy policy and public subprocessor list. Zeki AI is the product’s own AI branding, not an identified underlying model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: SOC 2 is specifically Type II. GDPR is claimed compliance, not a certification; it is included because the requested categories explicitly include GDPR.

last_funding.notes: Dealroom reports a $2.0 million Series A in September 2025. The company’s September 3 announcement calls it a strategic investment and does not disclose the amount.

raised_18mo.notes: Strategic investment announced September 3, 2025, within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Business Development Representative–Jordan; posted October 1, 2026, with an application deadline of December 30, 2026.

launched_6mo.notes: Dengage announced Smart Search Overlays on October 21, 2026, within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Mirza Mansoor Baig became VP of Customer Experience in December 2025; Rob Hunter’s VP International Sales & Global Partnerships tenure ended in April 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The BDR posting explicitly calls Zoho “our CRM” and describes prospecting for companies and decision-makers in Apollo; these are internal-use signals rather than merely supported integrations.
